# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148, and rolls up the 4.147.x previews. It adds variable fonts, color font palettes and animated WebP encoding, reworks the singleton lifecycle, and refreshes native dependencies. This is a breaking release for typeface null-handling and Vulkan Ganesh setup — check the changes below before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **SKFont and SKPaint no longer resolve a lazy default typeface** — `new SKFont().Typeface` is now `SKTypeface.Empty` instead of `null`, so `MeasureText` returns 0 until you set a typeface; construct with `new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)` and check `Typeface.IsEmpty` instead of `== null`. `new SKPaint().Typeface` now returns `SKTypeface.Default` instead of `null`, but text still draws out of the box. ([#3735](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3735), [#3736](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3736))
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName and SKTypeface.Default are now never null** — `FromFamilyName("missing")` returns `SKTypeface.Default` on every platform (previously `null` on Android), and `SKTypeface.Default` is guaranteed non-null everywhere. For a strict "was it found?" check, use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name, style)`, which still returns null on no match. ([#3737](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3737), [#3738](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3738))
- **SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete** — The native offset is a 32-bit int; out-of-range values now throw `OverflowException` instead of silently truncating, and the overload carries an [Obsolete] (CS0618) warning. Call `Move(int)` with a validated, in-range offset instead. ([#3740](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3740))
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null** — Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1; a 1.0 instance or device makes Skia call SK_ABORT and terminate the process rather than let CreateVulkan fail gracefully. Declare `VK_API_VERSION_1_1` on both the `VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion` and `GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion` (do not leave MaxAPIVersion at its default 0). Genuinely 1.0-only hardware can no longer run Ganesh Vulkan. ([#4600](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4600))
- **GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five interop fields** — `fMinAPIVersion`, `fInstanceVersion`, `fExtensions`, `fFeatures`, and `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice` were removed. Delete those assignments; use `fVkExtensions` in place of `fExtensions` and `fDeviceFeatures`/`fDeviceFeatures2` in place of `fFeatures`. There is no replacement for `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice`. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped, and GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value-equality** — The property is now `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo` (was `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo`), which gained a new `Components` field and no longer implements `IEquatable<T>` or the `==`/`!=` operators. Update manual struct construction for the new field, and replace equality checks with member comparisons. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose lost its public setter** — The protected `IgnorePublicDispose` property is now get-only. Code that set it directly must move that logic into the constructor or a dedicated method.

## Engine

- **Skia updated through milestones 132, 133, and 147 to m148** — Bundles the v4 Skia engine jump from m119 to m148, rolling up several rounds of upstream chrome/m147 bug fixes along the way. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081))

## API Surface

- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, and adds color font palette support alongside general variable-font robustness improvements. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream access** — SKWebpEncoder can now encode animated WebP images, and the new SKStream.GetData() gives zero-copy access to stream contents as SKData. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **SKSamplingOptions support and new HarfBuzzSharp APIs** — SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface gain SKSamplingOptions overloads, and HarfBuzzSharp adds the HBColor struct plus several missing API wrappers with corrected naming. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **Legacy paint/text obsoletes promoted to compiler errors** — The pre-v4 obsolete SKPaint text/font members and remaining legacy paint state-reading APIs are now compile errors rather than warnings, completing the v3→v4 migration path. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))

## Bug Fixes

- **Fixed pixel-span offset and stride bugs** — SKPixmap.GetPixelSpan<T>(x, y) used Height instead of Width when computing the offset, and both SKPixmap and SKBitmap GetPixelSpan used the wrong value for stride; both now use RowBytes correctly. ([#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148))
- **Fixed a SKPath finalizer crash and MAUI rendering glitch** — SKPath no longer crashes in its finalizer when the backing SKPathBuilder is collected first, and SKGLView now redraws correctly after a MAUI TabBar tab switch. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges), [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796), [#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **Fixed WinUI Projection DLL resolution for .NET 9** — Consumers targeting .NET 9 no longer hit a missing WinUI Projection DLL at runtime. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Reworked the singleton lifecycle** — Reworks how SkiaSharp's internal singleton instances are initialized and disposed, and moves the native-compatibility gate from a [ModuleInitializer] to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup ordering. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080), [#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Expanded native asset and target framework support** — Adds Linux Bionic native assets, x64/arm64 Tizen native builds, PolySharp support for C# 13 on legacy TFMs, and splits Apple TFMs into unversioned app / 26.0 library targets; WASM drops native builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3642](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3642), [#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798), [#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## Security

- **Refreshed bundled native dependencies** — Updates libpng, libexpat/expat, zlib, freetype, libjpeg-turbo, and HarfBuzz to their latest patched versions. ([#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Bundles HarfBuzz 14.2.0 with variable font shaping support, the new HBColor value type, and several corrected API wrapper names.
